svg.title: Render time relative to memcpy across 3 core workloads and 11 showcase pages
svg.desc: Each denominator copies the workload’s pre-rendered Proa HTML into a warmed, preallocated buffer. Cards — Memcpy control: 1.00× memcpy, P50 257 ns, range 208 ns to 304 ns, 25,108 bytes; Proa: 7.63× memcpy, P50 1.96 µs, range 1.75 µs to 2.42 µs, 25,108 bytes; Marko 6: 29.8× memcpy, P50 7.67 µs, range 7.13 µs to 8.96 µs, 24,038 bytes; Topcoat: 47.4× memcpy, P50 12.2 µs, range 11.3 µs to 12.5 µs, 25,108 bytes; Leptos: 81.2× memcpy, P50 20.9 µs, range 20.7 µs to 21.5 µs, 25,219 bytes; Rails 8.1.3.1 Action View: 225.7× memcpy, P50 58 µs, range 58 µs to 59 µs, 35,839 bytes; React 19: 278.5× memcpy, P50 71.6 µs, range 70.8 µs to 75 µs, 25,202 bytes; Dioxus: 406.9× memcpy, P50 105 µs, range 104 µs to 105 µs, 25,141 bytes. 96-product grid — Memcpy control: 1.00× memcpy, P50 3.33 µs, range 3.33 µs to 3.4 µs, 284,908 bytes; Proa: 7.75× memcpy, P50 25.8 µs, range 23.8 µs to 26 µs, 284,908 bytes; Marko 6: 24.4× memcpy, P50 81.1 µs, range 79.3 µs to 84.2 µs, 282,604 bytes; Topcoat: 44.1× memcpy, P50 147 µs, range 144 µs to 148 µs, 284,908 bytes; Leptos: 62.4× memcpy, P50 208 µs, range 192 µs to 211 µs, 286,063 bytes; Rails 8.1.3.1 Action View: 118.3× memcpy, P50 394 µs, range 393 µs to 396 µs, 296,823 bytes; React 19: 116.8× memcpy, P50 389 µs, range 388 µs to 392 µs, 285,868 bytes; Dioxus: 88.5× memcpy, P50 295 µs, range 292 µs to 297 µs, 285,868 bytes. 1,000-row table — Memcpy control: 1.00× memcpy, P50 11.5 µs, range 11.4 µs to 11.7 µs, 988,509 bytes; Proa: 31.3× memcpy, P50 360 µs, range 356 µs to 375 µs, 988,509 bytes; Marko 6: 80.1× memcpy, P50 922 µs, range 917 µs to 929 µs, 983,187 bytes; Topcoat: 87.8× memcpy, P50 1.01 ms, range 1 ms to 1.03 ms, 988,509 bytes; Leptos: 151.8× memcpy, P50 1.75 ms, range 1.74 ms to 1.75 ms, 991,512 bytes; Rails 8.1.3.1 Action View: 504.0× memcpy, P50 5.8 ms, range 5.75 ms to 5.85 ms, 1,228,793 bytes; React 19: 296.8× memcpy, P50 3.42 ms, range 3.37 ms to 3.47 ms, 990,695 bytes; Dioxus: 188.4× memcpy, P50 2.17 ms, range 2.16 ms to 2.2 ms, 990,695 bytes. Matched Proa output allocation capture: Both Proa variants include allocation, page construction and runtime tags. Full-size rendering uses an exact-size contiguous Vec writer; the default uses 4 KiB chunks. Cards: default 1.96 µs (9.30× memcpy), full-size 1.17 µs (5.54× memcpy), copy 211 ns, speedup 1.68×. 96-product grid: default 25 µs (7.51× memcpy), full-size 15.5 µs (4.64× memcpy), copy 3.33 µs, speedup 1.62×. 1,000-row table: default 241 µs (20.9× memcpy), full-size 270 µs (23.5× memcpy), copy 11.5 µs, speedup 0.89×. Airbnb home: default 13 µs (6.80× memcpy), full-size 6.75 µs (3.52× memcpy), copy 1.92 µs, speedup 1.93×. Airbnb search: default 3.46 µs (8.16× memcpy), full-size 1.88 µs (4.42× memcpy), copy 424 ns, speedup 1.84×. Airbnb listing: default 17.4 µs (22.7× memcpy), full-size 14 µs (18.2× memcpy), copy 766 ns, speedup 1.24×. Nike catalog: default 19.4 µs (18.8× memcpy), full-size 14.2 µs (13.8× memcpy), copy 1.03 µs, speedup 1.36×. Nike product: default 5.17 µs (10.8× memcpy), full-size 2.92 µs (6.07× memcpy), copy 480 ns, speedup 1.77×. eBay cards: default 35.3 µs (12.5× memcpy), full-size 31.9 µs (11.3× memcpy), copy 2.82 µs, speedup 1.11×. eBay chrome: default 48.1 µs (7.89× memcpy), full-size 31.7 µs (5.20× memcpy), copy 6.09 µs, speedup 1.52×. eBay real chrome: default 61 µs (6.60× memcpy), full-size 33 µs (3.58× memcpy), copy 9.24 µs, speedup 1.85×. ESPN game page: default 8.08 µs (29.2× memcpy), full-size 8.25 µs (29.8× memcpy), copy 277 ns, speedup 0.98×. Sentry OTel, 400 rows: default 135 µs (13.3× memcpy), full-size 150 µs (14.7× memcpy), copy 10.2 µs, speedup 0.90×. Settings console: default 2.92 µs (38.0× memcpy), full-size 2.83 µs (36.9× memcpy), copy 77 ns, speedup 1.03×.
svg.text: P50 / hot-buffer copy · log scales · lower is better
Full-size capacity is known before timing. Copy: warmed, reused buffers; allocation excluded. Ranges: process P50 min–max.
